line: fld     [esp+easeOutTime]; BSAnimGroupSequence deactivation wrapper. Delegates to NiControllerSequence_Deactivate with the secondary stop flag forced to zero.
call    NiControllerSequence_Deactivate; Native controller-sequence deactivation. Immediate stop clears active state/controller links; positive ease-out enters state 3 or 4 and records fade timing.
